description: Built December 1975; delivered 23 January 1976; registered 3 February 1976 as CCCP-87492 to the Kazakh Civil Aviation Directorate at Ust-Kamenogorsk; passed to Kazakhstan 1992 as UN-87492; flown by Irtysh-Avia and later Air Kazakhstan; installed 2011 as an exhibit of the East Kazakhstan Ethnographic Museum in the Left Bank park; year_built from the registry's stated build month
